description: Scientists discovered that a giant atmospheric wave on Venus behaves like a hydraulic jump seen in kitchen sinks. The process may explain the planet’s enormous sulfuric acid cloud front and its unusually fast atmospheric super rotation.
title: Scientists Solve Venus Cloud Puzzle Using Simple Fluid Dynamics

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 could launch in the second half of this year. Now, new protective cases for the flip-style foldable phone have leaked online. The renders show a design similar to last year's Galaxy Z Fold 7. It is expected to come with a dual rear camera unit and a hole-punch display design. The  Galaxy Z Flip 8 is speculated to feature a 4,300mAh battery.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 8 Case Renders Hint at Design and Qi2 Charging Support

description: Meta has rolled out a major update for the Meta Ray-Ban Display, adding Neural Handwriting, display recording, expanded Live Captions, and broader navigation support. The company has also opened a developer preview that lets developers build web apps and extend mobile apps to the glasses. Meta said Muse Spark, a new AI model for its wearables, will arrive later this summer. The update follows four software releases issued since the smart glasses launched in September 2025.
title: Meta Brings Neural Handwriting on Ray-Ban Display to All Users, Lets Developers Build Third-Party Apps

description: THORChain has halted trading operations after blockchain investigator ZachXBT flagged a suspected exploit involving more than $10 million in assets. Several blockchain analytics firms have also identified suspicious activity linked to the protocol.
title: THORchain Halts Trading after Suspected $10 Million Exploit

description: Honor CEO Glory Li Jian (transalted from Chinese) during the Cannes Film Festival confirmed that the Honor Robot Phone will be launched in Q3 this year. Honor has also confirmed its association with ARRI for its professional cinema and filmmaking cameras. Honor Robot Phone was first showcased during the launch of Honor Magic 8 series last year. It was previewed earlier this year during the MWC 2026 in Barcelona.
title: Honor’s Robot Phone With a Rotating Gimbal Camera Gets an Official Launch Window

description: Meta-owned WhatsApp is rolling out a new disappearing messages option to some iPhone beta testers. The feature, previously spotted on Android, lets users delete messages after they are read, with post-read timers of 5 minutes, 1 hour, or 12 hours. Unread messages are automatically removed after 24 hours. The feature is available in WhatsApp beta for iOS 26.19.10.72 and works alongside the existing 24-hour, 7-day, and 90-day disappearing message timers.
title: WhatsApp Reportedly Begins Beta Testing View-Once Disappearing Messages Feature on iOS

description: Subnautica 2 has sold 2 million copies in just 12 hours after its early access launch. The survival title released in early access on May 14 on PC and Xbox Series S/X. Subnautica 2 has also reached over 400,000 peak concurrent players on Steam within hours of launch.
title: Subnautica 2 Sells 2 Million Copies Within 12 Hours of Early Access Launch

description: Samsung Galaxy M47 has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number SM-476B, according to a tipster. The handset reportedly appeared on the benchmarking platform with octa core Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset. The rumoured Samsung M series smartphone is said to deliver a peak clock speed of 2.4GHz. Moreover, the Samsung Galaxy M47 was spotted with 8GB of RAM and Android 16. It reportedly managed to score 2,256 points in terms of GPU performance on Geekbench AI’s OpenCL test.
title: Samsung Galaxy M47 With Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 Chipset Reportedly Listed on Geekbench

description: The Motorola Edge 70 Pro has a premium design and a sleek profile. The handset packs a vivid 6.8-inch AMOLED display with good viewing angles. The handset also comes with a MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Extreme processor, capable of delivering strong performance for the price. The phone also features a dual-camera setup that delivers decent results in different lighting conditions. The device features a 6,500mAh battery and supports 90W fast charging.

description: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) on Friday announced that the existing mAadhaar app will soon be discontinued. It has encouraged users to migrate to the recently launched Aadhaar app. Available on both the App Store for iPhone and the Google Play Store for Android, it is aimed at helping citizens securely store their Aadhaar information, keep it updated, and share it with others. The new app carries features like QR-based Aadhaar sharing, face authentication, biometric lock controls, and selective information sharing
title: UIDAI Urges Users to Download New Aadhaar App; mAadhaar App to Be 'Retired' Soon

title: Amazon Great Summer Sale 2026: Top Deals on Tablets Like OnePlus Pad Lite, Xiaomi Pad 8 and More

description: Kraken has switched its cross-chain provider from LayerZero to Chainlink CCIP following the Kelp DAO exploit in April. The exchange said the move is aimed at securing Kraken Wrapped Bitcoin and future wrapped tokens.
title: Kraken Follows Kelp DAO, Switches From LayerZero to Chainlink CCIP

description: East of Eden is an upcoming Netflix limited series that is an adaptation of the novel by John Steinbeck. It explores themes of good vs evil.
title: East of Eden OTT Release Date: Know When and Where to Watch This Upcoming Series?

description: The artificial intelligence (AI) space has started moving away from an “unlimited free buffet” pricing model for programmatic and agentic automation. After Microsoft announced that GitHub Copilot will move to a metered credit allotment calculated on token consumption instead of premium requests, Anthropic is moving towards a similar model. The company said that a monthly fixed credit will now be provided for programmatic use.
title: Anthropic Reverses Decision on Third-Party Agentic Tools, Allows OpenClaw Usage in Claude Plans

description: OpenAI’s pursuit of enterprise artificial intelligence (AI) market share has resulted in a shift of focus from ChatGPT to Codex. While the flagship AI app has received a couple of incremental updates, Codex has been aggressively upgraded and expanded by the team. In the last 30 days, the San Francisco-based AI giant upgraded the desktop app to support native computer use and web browsing, released the GPT-5.5-Cyber model, and added a secure sandboxing environment for Windows.
title: OpenAI Is Expanding Codex to ChatGPT Mobile App on iOS and Android

description: Ahead of HP’s Consumer World event, Gadgets 360 spoke with Vineet Gehani, Senior Director, Personal Systems, HP India, about the company’s evolving AI PC strategy and ‘OneHP’ ecosystem vision. During the interaction, we discussed how HP is positioning AI as a background layer that connects devices, workflows, and collaboration tools rather than treating it as a standalone feature. The conversation also explored HP IQ’s local-first AI architecture, the rise of edge AI computing, and new device categories like the OmniPad.
title: From AI Hype to Everyday Utility: Vineet Gehani Explains HP’s Vision for the Next PC Era

description: Thimmarajupalli TV is a Telugu rural drama now streaming on Aha Video. Set in the 1990s, the story follows a village thrown into chaos after its only television disappears. Filled with comedy, emotional moments, nostalgia, and suspense, the film stars Sai Tej Pulula and Veda Jalandhar in lead roles.
title: Thimmarajupalli TV Now Streaming Online: Where to Watch the Telugu Rural Drama Online?

description: Honor Win Turbo will soon be launched in China as the third addition to the smartphone maker’s new lineup, the compnay announced on Friday. Additionally, the company has also teased the design of the handset, which appears to feature a flat rear panel. The Honor Win Turbo will also sport a rectangular rear camera module, similar to the other two models in the series. Separately, a tipster has shared key details about the successor of the Honor Win, which was launched in China in December last year.
title: Honor Win Turbo Confirmed to Launch Soon as Honor Win 2 Lineup Details Surface Online

description: TSMC predicts that the global semiconductor market will reach $1.5 trillion (roughly Rs. 1,43,89,471 crore) by 2030, according to a Reuters report citing a presentation prepared by the Taiwan-based chipmaker for a tech symposium. Further, the chipmaker reportedly forecasts that AI and high-performance computing will account for a majority of this market share, nearing 55 percent. Meanwhile, smartphones are expected to account for a far smaller 20 percent share of the global semiconductor market’s size in 2030, the report added.
title: TSMC Forecasts AI Adoption Could Help Global Semiconductor Market Reach $1.5 Trillion Milestone by 2030

description: Garmin has been rumoured to expand its wearable portfolio with the launch of a new screenless fitness tracker in recent months. The purported wearable, dubbed Garmin CIRQA, has now surfaced in a fresh retailer listing. The leak sheds light on the alleged design of the fitness tracker and reveals some details about its expected pricing and sizing options. The information builds upon previous leaks, which hinted at Garmin’s plans to enter the growing display-free fitness band segment, currently dominated by Whoop and Fitbit.
title: Garmin CIRQA Screenless Fitness Tracker Retailer Listing Reveals Design, Possible Price

description: Google appears to limit free account storage to 5GB for new Gmail accounts without a phone number. Users who verify their numbers are provided the standard 15GB of free storage. With the latest move, several users criticise that the company will access more user data. A few users claim that the change will help the tech giant reduce spam. Users who need more storage can opt for Google One.
title: Google Testing Reduced Free Storage Limit for New Gmail Accounts Without a Verified Phone Number

description: Samsung may use the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 in its upcoming Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 series, according to a recent APK teardown. References to the chip were found in Samsung's AI Core app alongside several on-device AI features. Although no device name is mentioned, Samsung's recent use of MediaTek chips in the Galaxy Tab S10 and Tab S11 series makes the Galaxy Tab S12 lineup the most likely candidate.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Could Be Equipped With MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Chipset: Report

description: Xiaomi 17T and Xiaomi 17T Pro will be launched in select global markets on May 28, a tipster claims. The smartphones are expected to be launched in India after the unveiling of the Redmi Turbo 5. On top of this, the leaker has also shared that the tech firm is also holding conversations regarding the unveiling of the Xiaomi 17 Max in India. If this is true, the Xiaomi 17 Max’s arrival could take the total number of handsets in the lineup to five in India. While the Xiaomi 17 Max is confirmed to launch in China soon, the company has yet to confirm the Xiaomi 17T series’ arrival.

description: Lenovo Legion Y7000X 2026 will be launched in China next week. Ahead of the official launch, Lenovo has disclosed the key specifications of the laptop. It is confirmed to come with a 15.3-inch OLED display and an Intel Core Ultra 7 series processor. It has an 80Wh battery, and it will be available in two colour options. It will include 16GB DDR5 RAM and 1TB SSD storage
title: Lenovo Legion Y7000X (2026) Specifications Teased Ahead of Launch; Confirmed to Feature 15.3-Inch Display

The upcoming TWS earphones have been teased in black, green, and white colour options and are already available for pre-order. Vivo has confirmed features such as up to 55dB hybrid adaptive ANC, immersive panoramic sound, and up to 55 hours of total battery life with the charging case. Pricing and full specifications are expected to be announced at launch.

description: Apple’s partnership with OpenAI is said to be strained and facing growing tensions. According to a report, the ChatGPT maker is now weighing potential legal action against Apple over what it believes is a failure to adequately support and promote ChatGPT integration across iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.The partnership was first announced at WWDC 2024 and was initially believed to be a major step in bringing generative AI features to the iPhone ecosystem.
title: Apple-OpenAI Partnership Reportedly Strained Over ChatGPT Integration Across iPhone, Mac

description: Google is said to have begun rolling out a new feature on Android that provides AI-generated recommendations based on the users’ daily routine. As per a report, it is called Contextual Suggestions and functions as a lighter version of Magic Cue, the AI-powered predictive assistant that is exclusive to Pixel devices. While it was not officially announced during The Android Show, the report mentions that Contextual Suggestions is appearing for some users on stable Android 16 builds.
title: Google Reportedly Rolling Out Magic Cue-Inspired Contextual Suggestions Feature on Android
